title: Multi-Armed Beetle Deity
description: A multi-armed humanoid figure with a beetle-like head and horns sits atop a large mound of dark earth and insects. The scene includes a pentagram with candles and scarabs on the ground, ruined buildings with spiders in the background, and floating golden rings around the figure.
prompt: A surreal dark illustration of a multi-armed humanoid beetle deity with horns and a crown sitting in lotus position atop a massive mound of black earth crawling with beetles and scarabs, floating golden rings with symbols around its many hands, a large pentagram with lit candles and scarab beetles on the ground in the foreground, ruined gothic buildings with spiders and smoke in the background, glowing orbs floating throughout the scene, detailed ink linework with gold accents on black and white, occult mystical atmosphere
